blocks.text: RentalGateway wraps availability, holds and reservations so views never parse raw responses. Commands that can be retried carry an idempotency key, and responses that start a timer carry serverNow so the client can correct a wrong device clock.

Retry with the same key after a lost response

Release on a class change; a failed release is harmless because holds expire

blocks.title: Accessible countdown and search feedback
blocks.text: A polite live region announces the results count once a search settles, not on every filter change. The hold timer stays visible as text, speaks only at warning thresholds, and its warning opens a dialog with Keep holding and Release actions that work from the keyboard and return focus afterward. Date and time fields accept typed input, and every branch can be chosen from a list without the map.
